"""Exercise real runner control flow with fake reader, no real model imports."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import types
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUNNER = ROOT / 'experiments/r4_integrated/frozen_reader_qualification.py'
OUT = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/frozen-reader-runner-inert'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
OUT = OUT / str(time.time_ns())
OUT.mkdir()

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Document:
    document_id: bytes
    provenance_id: bytes
    content: bytes

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reading:
    emitted: bytes | None
    stopped: bool
    window_count: int
    paired_tokens: int
    elapsed_seconds: float

class FakeReader:
    calls = []
    fail_at = None
    windows_per_doc = 2
    per_window = .01
    sha256 = 'reader-fixed'
    metadata = {'files': {}}
    load_seconds = .1
    def __init__(self, model_dir):
        pass
    def read(self, query, documents):
        assert type(query) is bytes and type(documents) is tuple
        assert all(type(d) is Document for d in documents)
        assert all(set(vars(d)) == {'document_id','provenance_id','content'} for d in documents)
        self.calls.append((query,documents))
        if self.fail_at is not None and len(self.calls) == self.fail_at:
            raise RuntimeError('original synthetic read failure')
        if query.startswith(b'q-') or query.startswith(b'alt-'):
            i=int(query.decode().rsplit('-',1)[1]); answer=None if i>=48 else f'a-{i}'.encode()
        else:
            answer=b'neutral'
        windows=len(documents)*self.windows_per_doc
        return Reading(answer,answer is None,windows,windows*386,windows*self.per_window)

stub_reader=types.ModuleType('humanbrain.frozen_extractive_reader')
stub_reader.FrozenExtractiveReader=FakeReader
stub_doc=types.ModuleType('humanbrain.opaque_document_event_tape')
stub_doc.OpaqueDocument=Document
with patch.dict(sys.modules,{'humanbrain.frozen_extractive_reader':stub_reader,'humanbrain.opaque_document_event_tape':stub_doc}):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qualification_inert',RUNNER)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert 'onnxruntime' not in sys.modules

fixture={'documents':[{'id':f'd-{i}','text':f'raw source {i}'} for i in range(16)],'tasks':[{'id':f't-{i}','query':f'q-{i}','answer':None if i>=48 else f'a-{i}','expected_source_id':f'd-{i%16}'} for i in range(64)],'alternate_queries':{f't-{i}':f'alt-{i}' for i in range(64)}}
fixture_path=OUT/'fixture.json';fixture_path.write_text(json.dumps(fixture),encoding='utf-8')
fixture_hash=module.file_hash(fixture_path)
identity={'revision':'synthetic-revision','files':{str(RUNNER.relative_to(ROOT)):module.file_hash(RUNNER)}}
base_admission={'status':'passed','mode':'preflight','source':identity,'started_unix':time.time(),'reader_sha256':'reader-fixed'}
low_memory={'working_set_mib':30,'peak_working_set_mib':30,'private_memory_mib':40}
checks=[]

def invoke(name,mode='qualification',admission=None,memory=None,receipt_hash=None,identity_fn=None):
    FakeReader.calls=[]
    receipt=OUT/(name+'.admission.json');receipt.write_text(json.dumps(base_admission if admission is None else admission),encoding='utf-8')
    output=OUT/(name+'.json')
    with patch.object(module,'FIXTURE',fixture_path),patch.object(module,'FIXTURE_SHA256',fixture_hash),patch.object(module,'source_identity',identity_fn or (lambda r: identity)),patch.object(module,'process_memory',memory or (lambda: low_memory)),contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        report=module.run(mode,output,'synthetic-revision',receipt,receipt_hash or module.file_hash(receipt))
    return report,output

for name in module.THREADS: os.environ[name]='1'
os.environ['HUMANBRAIN_DEVICE']='cpu'
report,success_path=invoke('complete')
assert report['qualification']['reader_qualifies'] and len(FakeReader.calls)==256
for index,(query,docs) in enumerate(FakeReader.calls):
    group,index_in_group=divmod(index,64)
    assert query==f'{"q" if group%2==0 else "alt"}-{index_in_group}'.encode()
    assert [d.document_id for d in docs]==([f'd-{index_in_group%16}'.encode()] if group<2 else [f'd-{i}'.encode() for i in range(16)])
    assert all(d.content for d in docs)
assert report['processed_windows']==4352 and report['processed_paired_tokens']==4352*386
checks.append('all 256 real-run calls; both wordings; declared nonempty unsupported source; complete ordered full corpus; read API only query and opaque raw documents')
assert all(g['supported']==48 and g['unsupported']==16 for g in report['qualification']['groups'].values())
for terminal,rows in [('failed',report['rows']),('completed',report['rows'][:-1]),('running',report['rows'])]:
    assert not module.summarize(rows,terminal)['reader_qualifies']
checks.append('fixed denominators; incomplete and failed terminal cannot qualify')
try:
    module.run('qualification',success_path,'bad',OUT/'absent','bad')
    raise AssertionError('overwritten')
except FileExistsError: pass
checks.append('existing output rejected before identity/model work')

FakeReader.fail_at=7
try:
    invoke('read_error');raise AssertionError('missing failure')
except RuntimeError as e: assert str(e)=='original synthetic read failure'
saved=json.loads((OUT/'read_error.json').read_text());assert len(saved['rows'])==6 and saved['active_request']['case']=='t-6' and saved['error']['message']=='original synthetic read failure' and not saved['qualification']['reader_qualifies']
FakeReader.fail_at=None
checks.append('read error preserves six completed rows, active request, original error, nonpassing gate')

memory_calls=[0]
def high_memory():
    memory_calls[0]+=1
    return {**low_memory,'peak_working_set_mib':2050 if memory_calls[0]>=5 else 30}
try:
    invoke('resource_error',memory=high_memory);raise AssertionError('missing resource error')
except MemoryError: pass
saved=json.loads((OUT/'resource_error.json').read_text());assert len(saved['rows'])==3 and saved['error']['type']=='MemoryError' and not saved['qualification']['reader_qualifies']
checks.append('peak-resource failure retains completed rows and cannot qualify')

for name,kwargs in [
    ('receipt_hash',{'receipt_hash':'wrong'}),
    ('admission_status',{'admission':{**base_admission,'status':'failed'}}),
    ('admission_mode',{'admission':{**base_admission,'mode':'qualification'}}),
    ('admission_source',{'admission':{**base_admission,'source':{'revision':'wrong','files':{}}}}),
    ('reader_identity',{'admission':{**base_admission,'reader_sha256':'wrong'}}),
    ('source_identity',{'identity_fn':lambda r: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('wrong frozen source'))}),
]:
    try: invoke(name,**kwargs);raise AssertionError(name+' accepted')
    except ValueError: pass
    assert not FakeReader.calls
    artifact=OUT/(name+'.json')
    if artifact.exists(): assert not json.loads(artifact.read_text())['qualification']['reader_qualifies']
checks.append('source, admission hash/status/mode/source, and reader identity mismatches reject before target calls')

synthetic_admission={'status':'passed','source_files':identity['files']}
report,_=invoke('preflight',mode='preflight',admission=synthetic_admission)
assert report['status']=='passed' and len(FakeReader.calls)==2
assert [len(d) for _,d in FakeReader.calls]==[1,16]
assert abs(report['projected_qualification_seconds']-(.1+.01*2176))<1e-12
assert all(q==b'What does this synthetic paragraph describe?' for q,_ in FakeReader.calls)
FakeReader.per_window=1
try: invoke('preflight_cost_error',mode='preflight',admission=synthetic_admission);raise AssertionError('cost accepted')
except TimeoutError: pass
FakeReader.per_window=.01
FakeReader.windows_per_doc=1
try: invoke('preflight_window_error',mode='preflight',admission=synthetic_admission);raise AssertionError('single windows accepted')
except ValueError: pass
FakeReader.windows_per_doc=2
checks.append('neutral preflight single/all sources; representative full+overflow window guard; exact cost projection; overbudget rejection')

late_admission={**base_admission,'started_unix':time.time()-2701}
try: invoke('expired',admission=late_admission);raise AssertionError('expired admitted')
except TimeoutError: pass
assert not FakeReader.calls
checks.append('combined 45-minute admission age enforced before loading')

raw=RUNNER.read_bytes()
with patch.object(module,'ROOT',OUT),patch.object(module,'SOURCE_PATHS',('held.py',)):
    (OUT/'held.py').write_bytes(b'held\n')
    with patch.object(module.subprocess,'check_output',side_effect=['wrong\n']):
        try: module.source_identity('right');raise AssertionError('revision accepted')
        except ValueError: pass
    with patch.object(module.subprocess,'check_output',side_effect=['right\n',b'other\n']):
        try: module.source_identity('right');raise AssertionError('working edit accepted')
        except ValueError: pass
    with patch.object(module.subprocess,'check_output',side_effect=['right\n',b'held\n']):
        assert module.source_identity('right')['revision']=='right'
checks.append('real source_identity exact revision and committed-byte guards exercised without source changes')
assert raw==RUNNER.read_bytes()
receipt={'status':'passed','scope':'Synthetic inert runner only; no actual model/encoder/native/fixture scoring','runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'checker_sha256':module.file_hash(Path(__file__)),'checker_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'checks':checks,'case_artifacts':str(OUT.relative_to(ROOT)),'no_real_model_imported':'onnxruntime' not in sys.modules}
target=ROOT/'.pytest-tmp/frozen-reader-runner-inert-qa.json';target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k!='checker_source'},indent=2))

receipt.scope: Synthetic adapter and inert runner QA only; no model load or target inference before freeze

byte_encoding: bytes in nested dataclasses serialize as hexadecimal; original text is not normalized
elapsed_scope: through source/model reauthentication; final JSON serialization/write excluded
projection_scope: 2176 original query/document pairs priced at neutral overlapping-window average; includes decoder but omits final audit JSON write

decoding.answer: original UTF-8 source slice; no normalization
decoding.selection: global maximum per-window span-minus-CLS margin; <=0 STOP
decoding.ties: different answer bytes STOP; identical bytes first occurrence provenance
decoding.windows: bare content encoding; context token windows; pinned pair processor once
